intent: Bump to 2.11.1 — Blueprints canvas responsive frame + stage split
notes: v2.11.0 shipped with the Blueprints canvas frame pinned at the vault-HTML authored dimensions (1180×880), which meant on <1500px viewports the detail panel was pushed off-screen or clipped. Architect flagged the UX (had to reduce browser zoom to ~80% to see the full surface + sidebar + scroll behavior together). Small post-release hardening pass per Architect direction ("`v2.11.1` is the right kind of vehicle").

**Frontend restructure** (`views/blueprint.js`): `renderCanvas` now creates an inner `bp-stage` element inside `bp-canvas`. Stage carries the fixed authored width/height from the payload; SVG edges + all `<article class="bp-node">` positioned nodes are appended to the stage instead of the outer canvas. Interaction handlers unchanged — descendant selectors + event bubbling continue to work because stage lives inside canvas.

**CSS restructure** (`dashboard.css`): `bp-canvas` becomes a responsive scrollable frame (`flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; min-height: 0; overflow: auto`) — no longer carries fixed dimensions. New `bp-stage` block (`position: relative`; width/height set inline from JS). `bp-wrap` gap/padding tightened from 20px → 16px, height calc uses `var(--topbar-height)` instead of a magic 140 number. `bp-detail` becomes fixed-width `flex: 0 0 360px` with tighter min/max bounds (260/400 vs 300/420) so the detail panel doesn't fight the canvas for space.
**Charter TRIPWIRE** in `scripts-dashboard.md::Blueprints view`: new bullet naming the canvas-vs-stage split and warning against putting fixed pixel dimensions on `bp-canvas` (the pre-fix state).
**Version bump**: VERSION + pyproject.toml + charter version-note 2.11.0 → 2.11.1. PATCH bump (UX polish, no API change, no data change).
**CHANGELOG** `[2.11.1]` entry names the pre-fix root cause + the frame/stage split + compat note (endpoint contract unchanged; shipped data files unchanged).

Test coverage: existing `test_blueprint_view.py` tests validate the endpoint payload shape which is unchanged; no frontend-DOM tests exist (would need a real browser). Full sweep 977 pass + 3 skip + 2 xfail, zero regressions.
**Single-commit release train** — hardening is small enough to bundle the fix + bump into one commit rather than splitting.
